publications.title: Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals
publications.authors: Haozheng Luo*, Haoran Dai*, Jingyuan Huang*, Shaoyang Zhang, Xi Chen, Eric Hanchen Jiang, Yijiang Li, Chenghao Qiu, Chenwei Xu, Zhenyu Pan, Haotian Zhang, Binghui Wang, and Yan Chen
publications.summary: Understanding how attention sinks and activation outliers interact with cross-layer routing, and using null-aware attention to improve model robustness.
publications.contribution: I contributed controlled interventions and layer-wise representation analysis to study the relationship between attention sinks and activation outliers.

publications.title: KnowSim: Evaluating Information Calibration in LLM Assistants with User Simulators that Learn
publications.authors: Yoonjoo Lee, Hyoungwook Jin, Tae Soo Kim, Shaoyang Zhang, Philippe Laban, and Q. Vera Liao
publications.summary: Evaluating whether assistants adapt to what a user knows, with user simulators whose explicit knowledge states evolve throughout a conversation.
publications.contribution: I built experimental infrastructure for knowledge-state-aware simulation, conversation analysis, and the initial end-to-end human validation study, then iterated on these systems through pilot feedback and failure analysis.

publications.title: Knowledge Graph Enhanced Interactive Fault Diagnosis O&M Approach Based on Large Models of Electrical Power
publications.authors: Xiaoyun Tian, Bin Liu, Jianzhong Yang, Bo Ai, Huailiang Zhao, and Shaoyang Zhang
publications.extra: Power System and Green Energy Conference
publications.summary: Combining knowledge graphs and large models for interactive fault diagnosis in electrical power systems.
publications.contribution: Co-author on applied research at the intersection of domain knowledge and machine learning for power-system operations.
